rules: Sulcata-specific evidence must never be rendered as Leopard-specific evidence.
Horsfield does not automatically inherit Mediterranean Testudo food verdicts.
Wild consumption is observational evidence, not captive staple approval.
Plant nutrient data alone cannot generate a tortoise feeding verdict.

evidence_transfer_policy.principle: Comparative herbivorous-reptile evidence may inform hypotheses and risk screening, never directly establish tortoise plant-feeding safety.

evidence_classes.tortoise_direct: Direct tortoise feeding, clinical or field evidence; record exact taxon and study design.
evidence_classes.other_herbivorous_reptile: Indirect cross-taxon physiology, digestion, preference or toxicity; retain source taxon and prohibit automatic verdict promotion.
evidence_classes.plant_chemistry: Botanical nutrient/toxin measurements; require scientific identity, sampled part, processing and wet/dry basis; cannot independently establish feeding safety.
evidence_classes.veterinary_husbandry: Veterinary/zoo/husbandry guidance; identify intended taxon and whether advice is empirical or research-backed.

transfer_rules: Never treat acceptance, preference or digestion by iguanas or other herbivorous lizards as proof of safety for tortoises.
Species-specific toxicity, gut fermentation, fibre digestibility, mineral absorption and feeding frequencies cannot be transferred without tortoise-specific corroboration.
Plant chemical composition is an ingredient property; its clinical implications are animal-specific.
No automated grade promotion from cross-taxon evidence or plant composition alone.
When exact plant identity, part or measurement basis is missing, flag the mismatch rather than fill with a surrogate value.
Direct tortoise evidence and indirect comparative evidence must be displayed separately.
